project.title: Microbiome and transcriptomic analysis of cathodic biofilms of MEC and anaerobic granular sludge of an UASB, with DNA and RNA extraction
project.description: The main aim of this study was to assess the performance of the biocathode of a lab-scale MEC to convert CO2 into CH4 as a technology for upgrading the biogas produced in anaerobic digesters, comparing two electromethanogenic biomass enrichment strategies: i) direct biomass enrichment in the biocathode of the MEC; ii) external biomass enrichment in a methanol-fed upflow anaerobic sludge blanket reactor (UASB). The evolution of the microbial community was evaluated in terms of composition and activity by the use of quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) and high throughput sequencing of DNA and RNA.
